A vocoder is just a single discrete fourier transform with some extra steps, and harmonic synthesis stacks sine waves on top of each other until they sound like something else.
The digital signal processor chips used in synthesizers are pretty much just fourier transform engines.

Ophidian might've been intentionally referencing the Fourier principle -- but if he wasn't, I don't think the similarity is a complete coincidence.
